tokens.gl-font-display: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
tokens.gl-font-body: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

notes: Life OS is a daily-use PWA, so no immersive loader (GetLayers guidance for app shells). Font: Inter (the owner's typography system, docs/typography.md), self-hosted in assets/fonts so it works offline; it replaced Manrope from the GetLayers catalogue. Meridian was placed on the Today and Body stage cards, then removed at the owner's request: cards are one solid brand colour. Buttons borrow Aerra's sheen + arrow tile and Relay's clockwise ring; entrances use the house blur-rise reveal. Colours are the owner's brand palette: white for light mode, black for dark mode, #0071e3 as the only accent (lifted to #2997ff only for blue text in dark mode), the greys kept minimal. No element mixes colours; status reads through the greys, red only for delete and errors. All tokens live in css/tokens.css.
